method: Paired round medians; bootstrap resamples launches, then blocks within each launch.

metadata.scope: Prebaked opaque cubes; one orthographic camera; three aligned depth layers; shadows, light/reflection probes, instancing and authoring colliders disabled; no UI or scripted movement during measurement. All four modes use the same camera per scale.
metadata.timingDefinition: FrameTimingManager CPU total includes waits; GPU is native frame duration including phase gaps, not isolated shader work. Fixed 16-record offset in 32 records sorted by timestamp. Player waits for splash and focus, then 3 real seconds. Warmup uses both 90 frames and the configured minimum seconds; preconditioning uses Original. wall_delta_ms is observed loop duration, not display-present FPS.
metadata.gpuTimingSource: Metal GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime; explicit single-command-buffer camera scope, identity validated
